title: Parent ModSecurity v3 generic Git acquisition remediation is locally verified; hosted evidence is pending
title_de: Die generische Git-Akquisition von Parent-ModSecurity-v3 ist lokal durch die Framework-Provisionierungs-Bridge behoben; gehostete Evidence steht aus
protocol: ModSecurity v3 source acquisition and immutable provenance admission
profile: isolated Parent/Framework ModSecurity v3 runtime-component preparation; original MRTS remains read-only
security_assessment: The retained historical source-to-sink evidence validates a control-order and evidence-integrity gap, not a demonstrated lower-privileged attacker, upstream compromise, secret exposure, or successful hostile-PATH execution. Candidate c53ea5d removes generic V3 Git acquisition and delegates fresh source creation to the public Framework bridge at the Parent-recorded revision, then re-verifies and fail-closed publishes a sealed cache entry. Local Parent and Framework tests validate the direct remediation. Fresh exact-head runtime evidence, the terminal gate, and protected delivery remain pending.
security_assessment_de: Die aufbewahrte historische Source-to-Sink-Evidence validiert eine Control-Order- und Evidence-Integrity-Lücke, keinen nachgewiesenen weniger privilegierten Angreifer, Upstream-Kompromiss, Secret-Exposure oder eine erfolgreiche hostile-PATH-Ausführung. Candidate c53ea5d entfernt generische V3-Git-Akquisition und delegiert die Erzeugung frischer Source an die öffentliche Framework-Bridge bei der durch Parent festgehaltenen Revision, verifiziert danach erneut und publiziert einen versiegelten Cache-Eintrag fail closed. Lokale Parent- und Framework-Tests validieren die direkte Remediation. Frische Exact-Head-Runtime-Evidence, Terminal-Gate und geschützte Delivery stehen aus.
technical_claim: The historical Parent route could hand a generic ModSecurity v3 Git checkout to the shared build before immutable Framework admission. Candidate c53ea5d no longer invokes generic prepare_git_component for V3: Framework owns fresh approved acquisition, while Parent owns only safe staging reservation, re-verification, metadata, sealing, and atomic publication.
entry_point: Parent runtime-component ModSecurity v3 source preparation before shared build/cache use
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: Historical: prepare_framework_approved_modsecurity_v3_source delegated to generic prepare_git_component before the later checkout guard. Current: configuration guard -> marker-only absent staging reservation -> Framework public immutable provisioner -> Framework checkout verification -> trusted metadata -> complete marker -> atomic publication -> retained build-time guard.
observed_behavior: The retained historical trace confirms the generic-acquisition ordering gap. In current candidate c53ea5d, negative Parent controls prove rejected configuration, bridge failure, and post-provision verification failure cannot reach generic acquisition, completion, publication, or the build sinks; the Framework exact provenance/fresh-root suite passes at 77d73de.
observed_behavior_de: Der aufbewahrte historische Trace bestätigt die Generic-Acquisition-Reihenfolgelücke. Im aktuellen Candidate c53ea5d beweisen negative Parent-Controls, dass abgelehnte Configuration, Bridge-Fehler und Post-Provision-Verifikationsfehler weder generische Akquisition, Completion, Publication noch Build-Sinks erreichen; die exakte Framework-Provenance-/Fresh-Root-Suite besteht bei 77d73de.
expected_behavior: Before Parent creates, reuses, or builds from any ModSecurity v3 checkout, fresh acquisition runs only through the fail-closed Framework immutable admission boundary; Parent publishes a cache only after a second Framework verification and complete managed marker.
expected_behavior_de: Bevor Parent ein ModSecurity-v3-Checkout erzeugt, wiederverwendet oder baut, läuft frische Akquisition nur durch die fehlgeschlossene unveränderliche Framework-Admission-Grenze; Parent publiziert Cache nur nach einer zweiten Framework-Verifikation und vollständigem Managed-Marker.
impact: Historical partial-build output remains excluded from FND-CROSS-0001 runtime evidence. The direct generic acquisition defect is remediated locally, but PR #55 cannot claim delivery or integrate until fresh exact-head hosted runtime evidence, FND-CROSS-0001, SonarQube, reviews, and protected checks pass.
impact_de: Historische Teil-Build-Ausgabe bleibt von FND-CROSS-0001-Runtime-Evidence ausgeschlossen. Der direkte Generic-Acquisition-Defekt ist lokal behoben, aber PR #55 kann keine Delivery beanspruchen oder integrieren, bevor frische Exact-Head-gehostete Runtime-Evidence, FND-CROSS-0001, SonarQube, Reviews und geschützte Checks bestehen.

evidence.summary: The historical source-to-sink trace proves that generic V3 acquisition and build could precede immutable Framework checkout admission. Stopped output is explicitly excluded from runtime evidence.

root_cause: The Parent historically treated ModSecurity v3 as a generic Git component and deferred immutable checkout admission until after acquisition and the shared build path.
root_cause_de: Parent behandelte ModSecurity v3 historisch als generische Git-Komponente und verschob unveränderliche Checkout-Admission bis nach Akquisition und Shared-Build-Pfad.
proposed_remediation: Implemented in c53ea5d: consume the existing Framework public immutable V3 provisioner, preserve Parent re-verification and build-time guard, and publish only a sealed verified cache. Remaining remediation is exact-head hosted evidence and protected delivery, not a Framework/MRTS source change.
proposed_remediation_de: In c53ea5d implementiert: den vorhandenen öffentlichen unveränderlichen Framework-V3-Provisioner nutzen, Parent-Re-Verifikation und build-time-Guard behalten und nur versiegelten verifizierten Cache publizieren. Verbleibende Remediation ist Exact-Head-gehostete Evidence und geschützte Delivery, keine Framework-/MRTS-Source-Änderung.
